whatIs: Swivel is a browser-based studio for placing a video or a design inside a 3D device mockup, such as an iPhone or a MacBook, and exporting it as a video or an image.
It's good for showing an app or a website in a launch video, a demo or a post, without installing anything.
uses: Recording your app and showing it inside an iPhone for the launch video.
Generating the App Store or Google Play listing images in the sizes the stores require.
Preparing a demo of your website inside a MacBook for the README or social media.
caveats: The free plan allows 3 exports every 24 hours and 15 every 30 days, with video up to 720p.
The free plan adds a Swivel watermark and is for personal, non-commercial use only.
For 4K, transparent WebM, batch export and client or ad work you need the Pro plan.
pricingNote: Free plan with limits and a watermark; the Pro plan is paid monthly, every 6 months or yearly.
idealFor: Developers who need video mockups to show off their app.
